title: vocabularies.resolve
description: Existence, labels and (optionally) parentage for a batch of term codes at one level. This object validates the request payload; the response shape ({exists, labels, is_child}) is documented in $defs.Resolution. One call answers every question ref_select validation asks about a submitted value, because asking them one at a time would be three round trips per listing.

codes.description: Term codes to resolve. Duplicates are collapsed.

parent.description: When given, every code is also checked for being a child of this term (the ref_select parentFeature check). Omit it to ask about the whole level.

language.description: Language tag to prefer for labels (Term.labels[lang]); falls back to the term's own label.

exists.description: {code: bool} — one entry per requested code, including the unknown ones.

labels.description: {code: label} — unknown codes are ABSENT rather than null, mirroring the projections read() convention; the caller falls back to the code, which is what format_value does.

is_child.description: {code: bool} when a parent was named, null when it was not. 'no parent given' and 'no code is a child of it' are different answers and the caller must be able to tell them apart.
